highlights_headline: This update strengthens Ganesh flush reporting and GPU buffer-upload checks on the m150 line.

bullets.detail: Separates whether a render task ran from whether it succeeded, correcting native success reporting after task execution or GPU submission fails.

Adds Ganesh buffer-upload checks under memory pressure to reject failed initialization and propagate checked upload failures rather than drawing stale data. CPU triangulation data is retained for retry; this is not complete upload-failure coverage.
